spans.s:
नृत् 1. नृत्, cl. 4. P. नृत्यति (ep. also -ते),
ननर्त, नर्त्स्यति and नर्तिष्यति,
अनर्तीत्, नर्तितुम्, to dance; to act on the stage;
represent (as an actor), gesticulate, play: Caus. नर्-
तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to dance: Desid. निनृत्-
सति and निनर्तिषति: Intens. नर्नर्त्ति, नर्-
नृतीति, नरिनर्त्ति, नरिनृतीति, नरीनर्त्ति, नरी-
नृतीति, नरीनृत्यते, to dance about, dance with
vehement gesticulations; (P.) to cause to dance
about or to and fro.
2. नृत्, त्, f., Ved. dancing, gesticulation, gesture.

नृति, इस्, f. dancing, acting, playing; (perhaps in
Ved.) lovely or grand appearance.

नृतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. dancing, gesticulating,
lively, active, (generally as an epithet of Indra);
(नृतू, ऊस्), m. a dancer, an actor, a mime; the
earth; a worm; length.

नृत्त, अम्, n. dancing, acting, gesticulation.
—नृत्त-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting in dance.

नृत्य, अम्, n. dancing, acting, dance, gesticula-
tion, pantomime.
—नृत्य-गीत-वाद्य, आनि, n. pl.
dancing, singing, and instrumental music.
—नृत्य-
प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of dancing; (अस्), m. a
peacock; (आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending
on Skanda.
—नृत्य-शाला, f. a dancing-room.
—नृत्य-सर्वस्व, अम्, n. ‘the whole essence of
dancing,’ N. of a work.
—नृत्य-स्थान, अम्, n. a
place for dancing, a dancing-room.
